title: Rockefeller pressure leads the Clinton administration to look into Roswell

tellings.quote: according to Podesta, Clinton was not happy with the answers they were getting. They were getting the runaround.

plain: In the 1990s, pressure from the wealthy philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller pushed Bill Clinton's White House to look into Roswell, the New Mexico case where a craft is said to have crashed and been recovered by the military. Clinton did not like the answers he got: 'They were getting the runaround.' The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells Michels this as it was told by John Podesta, a top Clinton aide, and points to a briefing document prepared for Rockefeller's effort. If true, even a president could not get a straight answer about Roswell.
